title: Access and refresh token members of a Figma token response
summary: A synthetic access_token and refresh_token member in a pretty-printed and a compact JSON token response, and an access_token member alone in a refresh response; the values have no documented prefix or width.
rationale: Figma documents the token exchange response as a JSON object with access_token, token_type, expires_in and refresh_token members, and a refresh request that returns a replacement access token. The member name is the carrier; the values are flagged because of where they sit, not because of any prefix, length or alphabet, none of which the cited page states. The extent is the string value only: the member name, the colon and the quotes are outside it. The expires_in number, the token_type word and the user id are not values of either credential.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the string value of an exact access_token or refresh_token member of a token response is treated as a credential whatever its shape and covered whole. Figma documents the response members (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and generic attribution are the project's decisions. No prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
